reason: We do library storytime, parks and church groups, and I almost never pay for kid activities. I'd maybe take the free first visit, but I wouldn't pay $14 to chase my kid around while a coffee goes cold.
objection: I'll still be chasing my kid, so I won't really get to sit and drink coffee, and the free options already fill our week.
would_change_my_mind: A very cheap or free option, like free weekday hours or a church-group rate, or a rainy-day need the library can't cover.
